children: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) has announced the signing of a SeleQtions hotel in Athirappilly, Kerala. This is a conversion and expansion project.

The 100-key IHCL SeleQtions Athirappilly is being developed in two phases. The first phase comprises the existing 37 operational keys, while the balance inventory will be added as part of the expansion. The hotel will feature an all-day dining restaurant, a wine and beer lounge and a rooftop dining experience.

For meetings and social gatherings, the hotel will offer spacious banquet venues and meeting rooms. Recreational facilities will include a swimming pool, fitness centre and a spa with multiple treatment rooms.

Suma Venkatesh, Executive Vice President - Real Estate & Development, IHCL, said, “Kerala continues to be a key leisure market with its diverse tourism offerings and strong connectivity. Athirappilly, with its proximity to the iconic Athirappilly Falls and easy access from Kochi, presents an attractive opportunity to further strengthen our presence in the state. The signing is in line with our focus on expanding our portfolio across distinctive leisure destinations. We are delighted to partner with the Kshema Group for this project and bring the SeleQtions experience to Athirappilly.”

Located in Athirappilly in Thrissur, the hotel is situated on the banks of the Chalakudy River, adjacent to the famous Athirappilly Falls, the largest waterfall in Kerala and one of the state’s popular tourist destinations. In close proximity to Cochin International Airport, Athirappilly forms part of leisure itineraries connecting Kochi and Munnar.
With the addition of this hotel, IHCL will have 25 hotels in Kerala, including 7 under development.

title: IHCL signs a SeleQtions hotel in Athirappilly
